title: LT7 census seal (DRAFT): hash exactly the files the censuses open (host originals first, then the q0600 restore tree and the LT6, LT5, LT4 and LT3 restore trees), each selected only if it is named in a source seal with an equal sha256, into seals/lt7_census_inputs.json; hashes bytes only, parses no rows (sample and capture manifests read for the slot assignment), nothing at or after 2026-10-22T00:00Z
expected_value: the LT7 input identity seal (design 7), committed before any LT7 census runs
data: restore trees live_tests{7,6,5,4}_census/restore (snapshots, sweeps) and live_tests{3,6}_census/restore (trade_samples; read-only)
outputs: data-dumps/research_lab/live_tests7_census/lt7_census_inputs.json (the orchestrator copies it to docs/research_lab/seals/ and commits it)
next_action: orchestrator copies the output to docs/research_lab/seals/lt7_census_inputs.json, commits it and pulls it on the host; the censuses refuse a seal not tracked by git or differing from HEAD. The seal needs spec census_inputs.source_seals.lt5_capture_seal_sha256 = fcd88926147051cba07d2094393d350faa7244828131e52bc9ee9b15bd108752 (set in the DRAFT spec) and refuses otherwise
notes: PROMOTED 2026-10-22 ~05:50Z (experiments autopilot) after the LT7 census-code check and its verification (FIXES_OK_WITH_NOTES; merged dde3c3c4). q0600 NOT promoted, by its own rule: the censuses are planned to run before the first loss (10-18 rows leave the host 10-28T03:30Z under the temporary 10-day rule, 10-26T03:30Z under 8 days), so the q0600 dependency was removed by hand as q0600's notes direct; its restore root is simply absent (roots are probed per file). If the censuses cannot finish before the first loss, stop and record it in the ledger; any re-seal (e.g. with q0600's restore root) needs a science-reviewer ruling first. argv unchanged. | UNAVAILABLE LIST (must-fix 1): the seal refuses a source-sealed file that is absent locally in a needed slot (a sidecar that failed to restore would otherwise silently make a capture sports = -1). Add `--unavailable <RESTORE_REPORT_<tag>.json>` (repeatable; its `missing` list) or `--unavailable <archive path>` ONLY for files q0600's report says no release holds; those directories are not selected and their slots are counted missing (listed under `unavailable_used`). The seal also records spec_sha256, design_text_sha256 and the hash of the spec's census_gates / census_inputs blocks; every census refuses a spec that differs. A missing source seal file is refused. | The seal lists exactly the files the censuses open: CC7 (captures k - 12 .. k of every origin, k - 84 .. k for CH192, the lag-only slots k + 2, k + 3), CS7 (sweeps k - 1, k and the pass pairs j, j + 13; captures k - 12, k - 1, k and j - 1, j, j + 13), CV7 (the 23 samples' features, manifest and trades files and their captures k - 1, k); it records the seal's own slot assignment, the genuinely missing slots per census and every not-selected file. A file named in two source seals with different hashes, or a hash mismatch, refuses the seal. DRAFT, not in queue/jobs (LIVE_TESTS_7.md text-frozen, sha256 840f4500...; code phase 1 only: the reader, analysis, size check and RSS probe are phase 2). Promote only after the science-reviewer code-freeze check of the census code and the committed seal. Counts 0 (descriptive; no trials line). Reads the DRAFT spec unpinned; code_sha256 of the hashed modules is written into the output. Every gate threshold is stated in LIVE_TESTS_7.md section 7 before this runs; nothing is re-tuned after it. Roots are repeatable (host originals first, then the q0600 restore tree and the LT6, LT5 and LT4 restore trees (and LT3's for samples), which are reused as extra roots: data-dumps/research_lab/live_tests5_census/restore (10-12, 10-13 partial), live_tests6_census/restore (10-13, 10-14), live_tests4_census/restore (10-14T22 .. 10-17 captures, sweeps 10-14..16), live_tests3_census/restore (the 23 C2 samples)). A sealed capture or sweep in a needed slot that is absent locally refuses the census; slots with no capture and nothing sealed are counted as missing, never substituted. The runner refuses (exit 2) a seal not tracked by git or differing from HEAD. Retention (10-day snapshot rule: day D leaves the host on D+10 at 03:30Z; sweeps are never deleted): see the q0600 and q0602 notes. Memory-heavy-jobs rule: exclusive; never while an LT5/LT6 census or size-check job runs.
